front.title: Border Gateway Protocol over Layer 2 QUIC Transport (BoL2Q)

abstract.t: This document specifies BGP over Layer 2 QUIC (BoL2Q), a transport for external and internal BGP sessions between speakers that share an Ethernet segment, in which QUIC packets are carried directly in Ethernet frames, identified by a dedicated EtherType, without IP or UDP headers. A BoL2Q session has no IP address and no transport port, so it cannot be reached from beyond the link on which it runs, and it requires no IP-layer configuration of any kind: a session is defined by a local interface, the MAC address of the peer, the remote Autonomous System number and a pre-shared key. BoL2Q reuses QUIC version 1 and TLS 1.3 unchanged, apart from the replacement of the UDP/IP path by an Ethernet path. Optionally, a "Link Next Hop" capability allows routes to be installed with a router on the same Ethernet segment as the next hop, identified either as the session peer itself or by its MAC address. This enables forwarding over links that carry no interface addresses, including through route reflectors and route servers.
